BackstoryDef.title: farm kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a remote farmstead, mucking stalls before sunrise and hauling feed until dark. The chores never ended, but neither did the fresh air and open sky.

BackstoryDef.title: preserver's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood in a smoky pantry-kitchen, learning to salt meat, seal jam jars, and judge a cellar's chill by feel. Nothing in the house was ever wasted.

BackstoryDef.title: homesteader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carved a working farm out of raw wilderness, raising crops and livestock with little more than hand tools and stubbornness. Winters were survived, not enjoyed.

BackstoryDef.title: farmstead brewer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a small but beloved farm brewery, fermenting cider and mead for every market day within a day's ride. Everyone knew [PAWN_possessive] name; few remembered their evenings.
